arabic_html:
يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱصْبِرُوا۟ وَصَابِرُوا۟
وَرَابِطُوا۟ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ ۞
translation: O you who have believed, persevere and endure and remain stationed and fear Allah that you may be successful.
explanation_html: The verse stacks three commands — persevere, endure, stay posted. Ibn Kathīr: be patient in faith and steadfast against what opposes it. Such patience, another verse says, is rewarded twice over.
